changelog:
Initial release of DataEcho skill for deploying files, static sites, and server-side apps built by agents.

- Publish any file, static site, or server-side app to a live URL via the DataEcho platform.
- Supports three deploy modes: single file, static site folder, and app folder with Dockerfile.
- Includes helper scripts for UNIX/Linux/Mac (bash + python3) and Windows (PowerShell).
- Allows claim and update of published sites; provides permanent or anonymous deployment.
- Features private, versioned Drives for cross-session file storage and sharing.
- Full REST API support with detailed deployment instructions and usage examples.
